procedure.title: Welcome & consent
procedure.note: Greet the participant, explain the study, and collect informed consent.

procedure.title: Demographics questionnaire
procedure.note: Short background questions (e.g. age range, AI familiarity).

procedure.title: Training / practice
procedure.note: Walk through the interface with a few practice trials so the task is understood before it counts.

procedure.title: Main task (trials)
procedure.note: The core trials where your dependent variables are collected, in the counterbalanced order from Study Design.

procedure.title: Debrief
procedure.note: Explain the study's purpose, answer questions, and thank the participant.

cognitiveParameters.label: Retrieval Threshold
cognitiveParameters.note: How easily info is retrieved from memory. Valid range depends on the task — forward simulation: -1.0 to 2.0 (default 0.5); counterfactual simulation: -2.0 to 0.5 (default -0.75).

cognitiveParameters.label: Opportunity Cost
cognitiveParameters.note: Accuracy-time tradeoff (computational rationality / RL). Forward simulation only.

cognitiveParameters.label: Diffusion Noise
cognitiveParameters.note: Stochasticity during forward simulation. Forward simulation only.

cognitiveParameters.label: Counterfactual Margin
cognitiveParameters.note: Margin when evaluating counterfactual changes. Counterfactual simulation only.
